name: megascenes-easter-card
description: Design Easter cards with your greeting, your message and your signature in the design, religious or not, in the look you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Write the main line, who the card is for, a short message and how you sign it, in your own words, religious or not, and pick the look: pastel spring flowers, painted eggs, cute bunnies, white lilies and a cross, watercolor. You get an Easter card with your words set in the design and its symbols drawn respectfully, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For family, friends, neighbors and everyone you send spring wishes to.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set your greeting, message and signature in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A pastel Easter card with spring flowers and painted eggs, signed Love, the Bianchis
A cute bunny Easter card for Nonna: Happy Easter 2027
An Easter card with white lilies and a cross and the words He is risen

positive.prompt: A pastel Easter card with spring flowers and painted eggs, signed Love, the Bianchis. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Easter card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A cute bunny Easter card for Nonna that says Happy Easter 2027. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design an Easter card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Easter card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A watercolor Easter card with painted eggs in a basket, square, with the words Wishing you a joyful spring. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my Easter card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my Easter card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
